name: Liar Taisen Janmagedon
original_name: ライアー大戦じゃんまげどん
source:
Main character Ueda installs new Liar Soft CD to the pc in the living room while his sister secretly watches him from a distance. Suddenly girl introducing as a new heroine appears on the screen asking for help in their fight against a nasty beast. The monster threatens to turn a pure love game into tentacles rape feast. As Ueda agrees to help, both he and his sister get transferred to the Liar Soft world.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角上田在客厅的电脑上安装了新的Liar Soft CD，而他的妹妹则在远处偷偷地看着他。突然，屏幕上出现了介绍新女主角的女孩，请求帮助她们对抗讨厌的野兽。怪物扬言要把一场纯粹的爱情游戏变成触手强奸盛宴。当上田同意提供帮助时，他和他的妹妹都被转移到了Liar Soft世界。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
